verdict: CONDITIONAL mechanism evidence; DO NOT claim row-lock+successful COMMIT is an unconditional remote-apply guarantee
proposal: Fresh-transaction FOR KEY SHARE of exact immutable receipt followed by COMMIT before replay success

facts.finding: Fresh successful row lock on permanent logged heap allocates XID, changes tuple locking metadata and emits XLOG_HEAP_LOCK. Transaction with XID+WAL reaches synchronous replication wait on commit. Receipt JSON bytes are unchanged but physical data/WAL are not read-only.

Not every row lock emits new WAL: already-owned adequate lock can return early, missing row returns none, temporary/unlogged relation does not require WAL. Candidate must bind fresh transaction/exact logged relation/actually found receipt.

Query cancellation during SyncRep emits WARNING, ends wait and still finishes local COMMIT. SQLx logs NoticeResponse warnings, not an error. Therefore tx.commit().await success can still acknowledge before remote apply.
Removing synchronous_standby_names wakes waiting commits; synchronous_commit mode without configured eligible synchronous standbys is not standalone durability authority.

FOR KEY SHARE requires UPDATE privilege on at least one column.0177 explicitly grants SELECT+INSERT only but does not revoke default UPDATE. Topology defaults may provide UPDATE; actual effective privileges must be measured, not inferred or silently widened.
Locks remain held through SyncRep. Concurrent key-share locks are compatible but MultiXact allocation/tuple-page WAL, DDL/exclusive blockers and connection occupancy grow on hot repeated receipts.

alternatives.assessment: Small conditional repair for observed backend-termination replay hole; must additionally handle SyncRep cancellation/config drift, explicit privilege contract and repeated concurrent replay. Do not describe it as lock-free or logically read-only.

Makes intent clearer and avoids receipt tuple lock/MultiXact hotspot if designed without one global markerrow, but own COMMIT inherits same cancellation/config semantics. Merely emitting WAL is not a complete fix.

After reading locally committed receipt, capture same-primary/timeline current WAL insert LSN upper bound; verify required standby/quorum has replayed through it using trusted observer before success. Avoids per-retry receipt WAL but adds observer privilege/protocol, epoch/timeline/cluster identity, quorum semantics and failover validation. Never compare bare numeric LSNs across unrelated timelines or DSN-derived identities.

before_code_requirements: Run keyshare+commit two-node probe, then cancel wait with pg_cancel_backend while standby remains paused; assert no durable success. Include statement timeout and loss of client connection separately.
Verify effective production runtime UPDATE privilege and minimally granted SELECT/INSERT-only control; preserve all immutable receipt bytes/rowcount.
Exercise many simultaneous same-receipt replays, owner lock/DDL contention, pool saturation, cancellation cleanup and retry after standby resumes.
Inventory all replay success exits and caller-owned transaction boundaries before shared primitive adoption.
Define durability success relative to configured failover-eligible replicas/quorum and authorized topology changes; remote_apply GUC text alone is not proof.
inventory_limit: Located8direct SELECTsites for ont_action_command_receipts;13reader-sibling claim not independently established. Other stores/indirect callers require explicit enumeration.
execution_limits: Read-only repository/source review. ExactPG18.6 sources fetched; no PostgreSQL experiment, code edit, Cargo/Buck/Docker execution by reviewer. Root owns live2nodeRED.
